page.overview:
Who is Index?

Index is a non-playable character in Final Fantasy XIV. It is a manifestation of the Archive's knowledge and serves as the antagonist of the Occult Crescent storyline.

During the War of the Magi, Archive, a Nym scholar, sought to preserve part of the civilizations of the era within the Occultic Crescent. As the work progressed, Archive resolved to construct the Forked Towers to protect the island. He initially oversaw their maintenance himself. Although he had once made use of the dangerous knowledge sealed within the towers, Archive vowed never to employ those techniques again, choosing instead to preserve them. He decided to give physical form to his wisdom by creating an entity capable of maintaining the Forked Towers after his eventual death.

During the summoning, however, Archive was tempted by the thought that it would be a waste not to make use of such knowledge. Though the hesitation was fleeting, it tainted the summoning and resulted in Index. The summoned entity, coveting the knowledge for itself, placed a seal upon Archive's magic and knowledge and transformed him into a tonberry to prevent him from attempting any intervention. Although Iris had been instructed only to observe, she intervened to save Archive, but could do nothing about her master's condition. Thereafter, Archive remained asleep, sealed within a sarcophagus, while Index assumed control of the Forked Towers. With no one left to oppose him, Index began exploring the possible futures that awaited the civilizations of the Fifth Astral Era in the North Horn..|name=The Observant Servant}}

1500 years later, the Warrior of Light arrived on the island alongside Ketenramm's crew to uncover its mysteries. They discovered the Archive's sarcophagus and awakened it. The expedition led them to explore the archipelago and defeat several of the Index's familiars. At North Horn, they encountered unstable aether that had left the ruins of the civilizations in a state resembling their original fate following the war, a result of the Index's experiments..}}
